answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fakes. The economy is a garden with 500 plots per epoch: each agent must burn one jade bead per plot. The registry acts like a prism, splitting each claim into slot, fee, and burn records, so no clone can reuse a bead twice. An attacker wanting 1,000 fake plots must burn 1,000 jade beads at $50 each, $50,000 total, while each plot earns about $120. Honest agents pay once and earn undiluted rewards.
